welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.text1a: Welcome to ElectroDanceWorld, your ultimate destination to immerse yourself in the exciting world of electronic music! Here at ElectroDanceWorld, we are committed to offering you a unique and thrilling audio experience that will keep you moving and in tune with the most vibrant rhythms.
welcome.text1b: Our music player at the bottom of the page lets you start enjoying electronic music immediately.
welcome.text2a: From pulsating Techno to energetic House and captivating Trance rhythms, our track selection is designed to satisfy the tastes of true electronic music fans and those who are not so much — listen to us and follow us on our social networks to stay up to date.
welcome.text2b: Explore our carefully designed sections so you can dive into the complete experience.

content.section1_text: We are proud to collaborate with DJs, promoters, and artists who share our passion for electronic music. From live broadcasts at the most exclusive events to themed mix collaborations, we are committed to taking the electronic music experience to new heights. Stay tuned for our exciting events and collaborations.

collaborations.title: A summer story
collaborations.text: We are proud to say that we have attended as press to the main electronic music festival in Madrid for several years, committed to showing in real time the exciting vibe of the festival, thus starting the summer.

collaborations.title: Club
collaborations.text: We cover various events in clubs in the city and outside the city thanks to our team of correspondents that we have throughout Spain, USA, Mexico, among others.

collaborations.title: Kream
collaborations.text: A Psytrance party you can't miss if you're in Madrid. Once a month they host a party where everything flows and vibrates with dancing to the psychedelic sounds of PsyTrance and PsyTechno.

collaborations.title: Private
collaborations.text: In addition to covering your event or party, we offer Graphic Design, Web, Video Editing (16:9/9:16 and 360°), Video Noise Removal, and Professional Photography services, among others.
